'''2007 Illinois State Championship Michael Pistone DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Dre Don't Just Stand There...Operate!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
